definitions.gloss: practice; real situation; on-site; in the field
definitions.explanation: The real place or real situation where something is done, as opposed to theory or the classroom. Used mainly before other nouns, as in {実地研修|じっちけんしゅう} (on-the-job training) and {実地調査|じっちちょうさ} (field survey).

examples.japanese: {実地|じっち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
⟦{新入社員|しんにゅうしゃいん}→新入社員：15536_shinnyuushain⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三か月|さんかげつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{実地|じっち}⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: New employees receive three months of on-the-job training.

examples.japanese: ⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、{実地|じっち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧みない⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{身|み}につかない→身につく：31476_minitsuku⟧。
examples.english: Even knowledge from textbooks doesn't really stick until you try using it in practice.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実地|じっち}⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧: on-the-job training
- {実地|じっち}⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧: field survey, on-site investigation
- {実地|じっち}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧: practical test (as in a driving test on the road)
- {実地|じっち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧: to learn by doing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{実践|じっせん}→実践：08241_jissen⟧: putting into practice (the act of practicing what one knows)
- ⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧: the actual site, the scene (a place, e.g. a building site)
- ⟦{理論|りろん}→理論：04708_riron⟧: theory (the opposite)
